rows.title_full: ACT RECLASSIFYING THOSE PERSONS IN AUTHORITY WHO DIRECTLY CAUSE OR ORDER THE DESTRUCTION OR CONCEALMENT OF VITAL EVIDENCES FOR HEINOUS CRIMES AS ACCOMPLICES, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE ARTICLE 18 OF THE REVISED PENAL CODE, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: Adds the following paragraph to Article 18 of the Revised Penal Code: "THOSE PERSONS IN AUTHORITY, LIKE MEMBERS OF THE JUDICIARY AND LAW ENFORCEMENT AGENCIES AND OTHER PUBLIC OFFICIALS, WHO DIRECTLY CAUSE OR ORDER THE DESTRUCTION OR CONCEALMENT OF VITAL EVIDENCE OR EVIDENCE FOLLOWING THE COMMISSION OF A HEINOUS CRIME, SHALL LIKEWISE BE CONSIDERED ACCOMPLICES"
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 1995-09-06

rows.author: A017
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING RAPE VICTIMS ASSISTANCE CENTERS IN EACH CONGRESSIONAL DISTRICT AND CREATING RAPE CRISIS DESKS IN EVERY POLICE PRECINCT, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Establishes rape victims assistance centers in each congressional district which will specialize in and will be committed in assisting rape victims in alleviating their stree, tension and trauma.  The centers will be manned by experts in handling the psychological, medical and legal aspects of the crime of rape, thus the centers will serve as immediate shelters for the victims. Creates rape crisis desk in every police precinct.
rows.status: Substituted by HB09962

rows.author: A017
rows.title_full: AN ACT MAKING RENTALS ON RESIDENTIAL/APA RTMENT OR OTHER DWELLING UNITS EXEMPT FROM INCOME TAXATION, ALLOWING THEM TO BE DEDUCTIBLE FROM TAXABLE FIXED INCOME OF THE TENANTS OR INDIVIDUALS WHO PAY SAID RENTALS
rows.abstract: Exempts rentals on residential/apa rtment or other dwelling units from income taxation. Seeks to exempt from income taxation that part of the ordinary Filipino's fixed income which is used to defray the cost of maintaining a dwelling unit. In so doing, the fixed income earner is somehow eased of the burden of providing a basic need for his or her family and is given the advantage of making savings for his or her future benefits.
rows.status: Substituted by HB09077
